decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 and given its own page, this product still looks like a live option whose demand is not yet fully revealed and whose near-term continuation cost is likely modest.
Although generic antidepressants face strong price competition, the 2024 launch and dedicated web presence suggest it is still too early to abandon before more market feedback arrives.
A newly launched combination antihypertensive with its own page fits a chronic-use market, so the option value of waiting for clearer sales evidence outweighs the short-run cost of keeping it listed.

Because it was only briefly mentioned rather than prominently presented, this supplement appears to be a lower-commitment and less strategic option that management would be more willing to discontinue after weak early signals.
